toml:
# Cross-domain composition: one jammer, two platforms. A ship in the Gulf of Finland
# (59.80 N, 24.90 E, the maritime-strait-jamming example's receiver) and a car on a
# Helsinki coast road (60.17 N, 24.94 E) sit under the same broadband jammer, placed
# at 59.80 N, 25.44 E, 30 m up (about 30 km from the ship and 50 km from the car).
#
# At 8 dBW (6.3 W) the ship loses every satellite (mean jammer-to-signal ratio,
# J/S, about 39 dB) while the car, 20 km further off, keeps at least four (about
# 35 dB): the combined summary names the ship as the worst platform.
#
# The jammer's power and position are declared once under [[compose.shared]] and
# written into each member at the keys it binds them to, so the two runs cannot
# disagree about the threat. Each member is an ordinary `jamming` run; the combined
# summary names the best and worst platform for each metric.
#
# MODELLED: as the `jamming` kind is. The car is modelled with the same open-sky
# receiver as the ship; urban masking and the vehicle antenna are not.
kind = "campaign"
title = "One jammer, a ship and a car"
seed = 20260928

[[compose.shared]]
name = "jammer_power"
unit = "dBW"
value = 8.0

[[compose.shared]]
name = "jammer_position"
unit = "m"
value = [2904623.523, 1381438.498, 5489328.347]

[[compose.members]]
label = "ship-strait"
bind = { jammer_power = "jammer.power_dbw", jammer_position = "jammer.position_ecef_m" }
metrics = [
  { name = "availability", path = "fom.availability_under_jamming" },
  { name = "mean_js", path = "fom.mean_js_db" },
  { name = "min_tracking", path = "fom.min_tracking" },
]
[compose.members.scenario]
kind = "jamming"
seed = 1
mask_deg = 5.0
tracking_threshold_dbhz = 25.0
[compose.members.scenario.time]
step_s = 30.0
duration_s = 1800.0
[compose.members.scenario.receiver]
lat_deg = 59.80
lon_deg = 24.90
alt_m = 0.0
[compose.members.scenario.constellation]
altitude_km = 20200.0
inclination_deg = 55.0
planes = 6
sats_per_plane = 4
phasing_f = 1.0
[compose.members.scenario.jammer]
position_ecef_m = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
power_dbw = 0.0
gain_dbi = 0.0
jammer_type = "broadband"
bandwidth_mhz = 20.0

[[compose.members]]
label = "car-coast-road"
bind = { jammer_power = "jammer.power_dbw", jammer_position = "jammer.position_ecef_m" }
metrics = [
  { name = "availability", path = "fom.availability_under_jamming" },
  { name = "mean_js", path = "fom.mean_js_db" },
  { name = "min_tracking", path = "fom.min_tracking" },
]
[compose.members.scenario]
kind = "jamming"
seed = 1
mask_deg = 5.0
tracking_threshold_dbhz = 25.0
[compose.members.scenario.time]
step_s = 30.0
duration_s = 1800.0
[compose.members.scenario.receiver]
lat_deg = 60.17
lon_deg = 24.94
alt_m = 0.0
[compose.members.scenario.constellation]
altitude_km = 20200.0
inclination_deg = 55.0
planes = 6
sats_per_plane = 4
phasing_f = 1.0
[compose.members.scenario.jammer]
position_ecef_m = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
power_dbw = 0.0
gain_dbi = 0.0
jammer_type = "broadband"
bandwidth_mhz = 20.0
